method: Bounded census: all current needs-mre labels plus five explicit Tier A/B bug-report requests; all 14 pre-freeze marked_as_duplicate issues with GraphQL direction checks; oldest 30 eligible non-duplicate, non-positive members adjudicated as MRE negatives; and code-computed stale set. Single-rater thread review; no model inputs were tuned on these outcomes.
